01.title: Target Successfully Bombed
01.description: The map Dust II from the video game series Counter-Strike, named "target successfully bombed" in reference to the video game.

02.title: Seaside
02.description: Mountains and a lake, with a small photo of a mountain and a bright-colored plant on the window ledge.

03.title: Kebab med tre pepperoni
03.description: A kebab with three green chili peppers.

04.title: Bust
04.description: A bust of Marcus Aurelius surrounded by fire.

05.title: Match
05.description: A hand holding a match, causing fire on a white cubic gas fireplace.

06.title: The Void
06.description: An angel praying into a void with fire below.

07.title: Wasteland
07.description: A view of some wasteland; a rabbit named Herobrine is sitting on the windowsill.

08.title: Paradisträd
08.description: Still life of two plants in pots. "Paradisträd" is Swedish for "jade plant", which is a common name for the depicted species in Scandinavia.

09.title: Albanian
09.description: A man wearing a fez next to a house and a bush. As the name of the painting suggests, it may be a landscape in Albania.

10.title: Wanderer
10.description: A version of Caspar David Friedrich's famous painting Wanderer above the Sea of Fog.

11.title: Graham
11.description: King Graham, the player character in the video game series King's Quest. The painting is based on Still Life with Quince, Cabbage, Melon, and Cucumber by Juan Sánchez Cotán.

12.title: The pool
12.description: Some men and women skinny-dipping in a pool over a cube of sorts. There is also an old man resting in the lower-right edge.

13.title: Bonjour monsieur Courbet
13.description: Two hikers with pointy beards seemingly greeting each other. Based on Gustave Courbet's painting The Meeting.

14.title: Sunset dense
14.description: A view of mountains at sunset.

15.title: The stage is set
15.description: Scenery from the video game Space Quest I, with the character Graham from the video game series King's Quest appearing twice.

16.title: Lemons and owl
16.description: A two-dimensional owl inside a box, next to some lemons. The background is based on the painting An Old Man and his Grandson by Domenico Ghirlandaio.

17.title: Oh, The Sea
17.description: A person sitting in a fetal position by a shoreline. The naked person from the original painting has been given clothes.

18.title: The Backyard
18.description: A brick archway with two women sitting in the yard. The scenery is based on the painting The Courtyard of a House in Delft by Pieter de Hooch. The figures on the right are from Jacques-Louis David's Oath of the Horatii.

19.title: Death and the Maiden
19.description: A maiden sitting in a pond, next to a half-submerged skeleton. Death and the Maiden was a common motif in Renaissance art, ultimately derived from the Medieval genre Dance of Death.

20.title: Fighters
20.description: Two men poised to fight. The fighters are from the video game The Way of the Exploding Fist. The backdrop is based on the painting Indian Summer, Vermont by Willard Metcalf.

21.title: Change of set
21.description: A person changing clothes in front of some set pieces, including a contrasting gloomy mountain and a sunny countryside. The figure is based on the person changing clothes from The Baptism of Christ by Piero della Francesca.

22.title: Mortal Coil
22.description: Bruno Martinez from the adventure video game Grim Fandango.

23.title: Kong
23.description: A paper-looking screenshot of the level 100m from the ColecoVision port of the arcade video game Donkey Kong.

24.title: Pointer
24.description: A fighter from the game The Way of the Exploding Fist in a fighting stance touching a large hand. It could also be interpreted as a play on Michelangelo's famous painting The Creation of Adam. The hand is the artist's own. The scenery is based on the painting Winter Landscape with Church by Caspar David Friedrich.

25.title: Skull On Fire
25.description: A skull on fire; in the background, there is a moon in a clear night sky. This painting is based on a Minecraft screenshot, with the grass block and the three-dimensional skull added on top.
